beats.html:
Debbie Reynolds was 66
when she played
Aggie Cromwell.

The witch everybody
remembers as the
fearless one was a
woman in her 60s.

She's 19. She has never
once been worried
about it.

Send this to whoever
thinks they left
it too late.

clip.match_reason: The turn is an old female being the unbothered one. The plate is Cesa, old and dressed and looking away from the lens entirely unconcerned. She is the proof of the turn, not decoration.

contract: Cesa is old and I am keeping the record while she is still here.
